title: Leveraging Association Context Retrieval in Knowledge Edit- ing to Build White-Box Attacks on LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.17836v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are granted increasing autonomy, it is essential to investigate methods that can induce unsafe behavior. We propose a novel white-box attack inspired by locate-then-edit approaches from the field of Knowledge Editing. Our choice is motivated by the observation that models edited with such schemes tend to assign unusually high prediction probabilities to the edit target, a property that is particularly advantageous when designing attacks. We modify the editing framework by incorporating as- sociative knowledge retrieved from the model, thereby extending constraint removal to an entire thematic category rather than being limited to prompts from a predefined dataset. Experiments with various archi- tectures demonstrate improved attack effectiveness over competing methods without dealing critical damage to general model performance.

translated_title: 利用关联上下文检索进行知识编辑以构建对大语言模型的白盒攻击
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）被赋予越来越多的自主权，研究能够诱导不安全行为的方法至关重要。我们提出了一种新颖的白盒攻击方法，灵感来源于知识编辑领域的“定位-编辑”方法。我们的选择源于观察到，使用此类方案编辑的模型往往会对编辑目标分配异常高的预测概率，这一特性在设计攻击时特别有利。我们通过纳入从模型中检索的关联知识来修改编辑框架，从而将约束移除扩展到整个主题类别，而不仅限于预定义数据集中的提示。通过多种架构的实验表明，与竞争方法相比，我们的方法在攻击有效性上有所提升，且不会对模型的整体性能造成严重损害。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于知识编辑的白盒攻击方法，通过利用模型中的关联知识扩展约束移除范围，有效诱导不安全行为且不损害模型整体性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a white-box attack method based on knowledge editing that leverages associative knowledge from the model to extend constraint removal, effectively inducing unsafe behavior without harming overall model performance.
